extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: Abell 2744 (z=0.308). Bergamini, Acebron, Grillo et al. 2023, A&A 670, A60 ('New high-precision strong lensing modeling of Abell 2744'), table B.1. 225 rows of cluster members used in the strong-lensing model: 202 with Type='s' (SPECTROSCOPIC member, zsp populated) and 23 with Type='p' (PHOTOMETRIC member, zsp empty). n_members_published_definition counts the 202 spectroscopic members. Instrument: compiled MUSE + VIMOS + literature spectroscopy (column r_zsp a-e gives the source). Selection function: SEVERELY BIASED FOR KINEMATICS - these are red-sequence cluster members selected specifically to be included as lensing-model galaxy-scale perturbers within the HST/strong-lensing field of view, magnitude-limited in F160W. It is a member LIST, not a redshift survey, so it must NOT be treated as a fair kinematic sample. Included for cross-identification of secure members only. Sky coverage is confined to the HST Frontier Fields footprint.
